title: Understanding Language Modeling Paradigm Adaptations in Recommender Systems: Lessons Learned and Open Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Discussed conceptually within a tutorial framework for LLM-based recommender systems, proposing assessment through user interviews, tracking adverse indications, and incorporating insights from external knowledge bases.

Discussed conceptually within a tutorial framework for LLM-based recommender systems, proposing assessment through user interviews, tracking adverse indications, and incorporating insights from external knowledge bases.

Examined conceptually as the tendency of models trained on e-commerce data to favor well-known brands over niche or upcoming ones, proposed to be assessed by evaluating short-term and long-term recommendation impacts.
